title: Compiler Manifest for Capability Studio Gate A1
description: Compiler Manifest output by the protocol compiler. products exact-set elements: type, path, rawFP. Per Design 01.

packageFP.description: Source package fingerprint. WireDigest of TypedFP('rg.gatea.package.v1', manifestEnvelope).

compilerVersion.description: Version of the compiler that produced this manifest. Strict SemVer.

optionsFP.description: Fingerprint of the complete compiler options object, including an empty options object.

products.description: List of compilation products produced by the compiler.

compilerProduct.description: A single compilation product output. Exact-set elements: type, path, rawFP. Per Design 01.

type.description: Closed product registry from 01 §4.2. Only ir and projection have normative product semantics; schema, fixture, and assertion are excluded until a specification revision defines them.

path.description: Path to the product artifact (normative reference).

rawFP.description: Raw content digest of the product (normative reference). WireDigest<ContentDigest>.
